articles.title: Plan your movement: Lagos shuts major Ikeja roads for Capital City Race

How was the timing of this event decided, and was there consultation with affected communities and business owners beforehand?

articles.title: NAFDAC destroys N22.73bn worth of unwholesome products in eight months

articles.hausa_translation: NAFDAC ta lalata kayan aiki marasa lafiya da karfi N22.73 biliyan a cikin buwan takwas
critical_questions: What happened to the seized products after destruction - were they documented and verified independently or only through NAFDAC's own records?
Of the 179 closed premises, how many have reopened and what enforcement mechanisms ensure they don't resume operations?
Who benefits most from these enforcement actions - are small local producers disproportionately targeted compared to larger manufacturers?
What is the breakdown of these N22.73bn products by category, and were any multinational company products included in these seizures?

articles.title: I have foamy urine
articles.summary:
It does not necessarily mean anything about your kidney function.Urine foaming is most likely caused by proteinuria. This means that there is an excessive amount of protein in your urine, which makes the urine foamy. 
The post I have foamy urine appeared first on Tribune Online.
articles.hausa_translation: Nina farin jiya - Ba lallai ba ne ya nuna wani abu game da aikin jijiya. Jiya mai bubbuga shine sanin da aka fi sani don proteinuria. Wannan yana nufin akwai yawa da yawa na protein a jiya, wanda yake sa jiya ta bubbuga.
critical_questions: Who is the medical authority behind this claim, and what are their qualifications and potential conflicts of interest?
Why does this article present proteinuria as the primary cause without mentioning other common causes like dehydration, urinary tract infections, or vigorous exercise?
Is this article evidence-based with cited medical studies, or is it assertion without substantiation?
Who owns Tribune Online and what is their editorial stance on medical/health content - is there any advertising or sponsorship from medical or pharmaceutical entities?
Why does the article emphasize that foamy urine 'does not necessarily mean anything' while simultaneously suggesting proteinuria as the cause - shouldn't proteinuria itself be concerning?

articles.title: Native intelligence meets artificial intelligence at Aké Festival
articles.summary:
The 14th edition of the Aké Arts and Book Festival has brought together writers, poets, publishers, artists, and cultural enthusiasts in Lagos to examine the value of African knowledge, cultural heritage, and creativity in an increasingly technology-driven and artificial intelligence (AI)-dependent world.
The post Native intelligence meets artificial intelligence at Aké Festival appeared first on
articles.hausa_translation: Sanin jiya ya hadu da sanin kwakwalwa a Aké Festival. Jerin 14 na Aké Arts and Book Festival ya tattara marubuta, mawakin, masu buga littattafai, masu sana'a, da masu sha'awar al'ada a Lagos don bincika ƙimar sanin Afirka, gida al'ada, da fasaha a cikin duniyar fasaha da jama'ar AI.
critical_questions: Who are the primary beneficiaries of this festival's framing of 'African knowledge vs AI' - is it serving genuine cultural preservation or cultural commodification for affluent audiences?
What specific 'African knowledge systems' are being elevated, and whose voices within African communities are excluded from this curation?
Why is the AI-versus-tradition narrative being promoted now, and whose interests does this binary serve in the technology and publishing industries?
What concrete outcomes or policy changes are expected from this examination of cultural value, or is this primarily symbolic cultural discourse?

articles.title: I want to lose weight
articles.summary:
If you wish to lose your belly fat, you first need to start a healthy diet and exercise program. The diet should be high protein, low fat, and medium complex carbs.
The post I want to lose weight appeared first on Tribune Online.
articles.hausa_translation: Nina so na sauke jiki - Idan kana so ka sauke jiki, dole ne ka fara da ciwon abinci da motsa jiki. Abincin ya kamata ya kasance mai protein, ƙarancin jibya, da matsakaicin carbohydrates masu rikitarwa.
critical_questions: Who is the author/health expert behind these recommendations, and what are their credentials?

articles.title: How Buhari’s Leadership, Policies Shaped Nigeria’s Development — Ex-Minister Sambo

critical_questions: What specific policies or achievements is Sambo attributing to Buhari, and are these claims supported by measurable data on inflation, unemployment, or infrastructure development during his tenure?

Read More: https://punchng.com/akodo-ise-sea-incursion-threatens-to-wipe-out-lagos-coastal-community/
articles.hausa_translation: Akodo-Ise: Tashin Ruwa yana gida da gida, gonaki da makarantau a Lagos
critical_questions: What specific mitigation measures or coastal protection infrastructure has the Lagos government implemented or planned, and why do reports suggest insufficient action?
Who owns the land being lost to sea incursion—are these communal lands, private properties, or government-designated areas—and how does ownership affect response priorities?
What role have coastal development projects, sand mining, or land reclamation schemes played in accelerating erosion in Akodo-Ise specifically?
Which stakeholders (developers, government agencies, environmental groups) have been consulted or excluded from solutions, and what are their competing interests?
Is this framed as a climate/natural disaster story versus a governance/planning failure, and how does that frame affect accountability and resource allocation?

articles.title: Pay or park: Ogun motorcyclists allege N20,000 police extortion
articles.summary:
Ogun okada riders in Ibafo allege police officers seize their motorcycles and demand N20,000 to N30,000 for release, leaving night commuters stranded.

Read More: https://punchng.com/pay-or-park-ogun-motorcyclists-allege-n20000-police-extortion/
articles.hausa_translation: Biya ko ajiye: 'yan okada a Ogun suna zargin 'yan sanda da cin hanci N20,000. Jami'an 'yan sanda a Ibafo suna kama keke kuma suna bukaci N20,000 zuwa N30,000 don a sake wa masu keke su, wanda ya bar marturin dare ba su da wuri.
critical_questions: What is the operational jurisdiction and legality of the police checkpoints where these seizures allegedly occur, and are there official records of such operations?
Who benefits from this alleged extortion scheme - is there evidence of systematic police involvement or could individual officers be acting independently, and where does the money go?
Why are only okada riders being targeted, and are there comparative incidents involving other vehicle operators or public transport that would establish a pattern?
Have the alleging riders filed formal complaints with the police hierarchy, the Nigeria Police Public Complaints Bureau, or civil rights organizations, and what was the response?
What is the source and verification status of the specific figures cited (N20,000-N30,000), and are these based on documented cases or anecdotal accounts?

articles.title: When love meets genetics: The importance of genotype testing (2)
articles.summary:
Genotype testing matters beyond marriage. A sickle cell patient explains why early screening, counselling and compassion help couples make informed choices

Read More: https://punchng.com/when-love-meets-genetics-the-importance-of-genotype-testing-2/
articles.hausa_translation: Lokacin da ƙauna ta haɗu da jenetiks: Mahimmaniyar binciken genotype (2). Jenetik testing ya fi mahimma fiye da aure. Mai ciwon sickle cell ya bayyana dalilin da yasa dukansu bincike da farko, shawarwari da ƙarfi suna taimaka wa jama'a su yi zaɓi masu fahimta.
critical_questions: Whose interests are centered in this narrative—healthcare providers, medical institutions, or the lived experiences of sickle cell patients and affected communities?
What specific data supports the claim that genotype testing leads to 'informed choices,' and are alternative perspectives on reproductive autonomy represented?
Why is 'compassion' framed as a solution when systemic barriers to genetic counseling access and healthcare infrastructure gaps remain unaddressed?
Who funds genetic testing programs in Nigeria, and could commercial interests in diagnostic services influence the emphasis on testing over prevention or treatment?
Are the voices of couples who chose different reproductive paths despite genetic screening represented, or does the article assume a single 'informed' outcome?

Titled “Omologo”, he had […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jama'a mai suna suka kai hari wa Rarara, mai yabawa na Tinubu, a Masallacin Jama'a na Abuja
critical_questions: What specific actions or statements triggered the mob attack, and who organized or incited the violence?
Why was a religious venue (mosque) chosen for this confrontation, and what does this suggest about the politicization of sacred spaces?

What is the broader political climate around music, praise-singing, and campaign propaganda in Northern Nigeria during this election period?
Were any arrests made, and how are different Nigerian media outlets (pro-government vs opposition-aligned) framing this same incident differently?

State Chairman of Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association of Nigeria (MACBAN), Ibrahim Yusuf Babayo, confirmed the incident to Daily Trust on Friday, explaining that the […]
articles.hausa_translation: Bakin gida an kashot a gida - Wata mutum mai shekara 45 da ake kiranta Alh. Wada Haruna an kashot shi da bindigu a lokacin da yake sallar Juma'a kusa da gida Maraban Kantoma a gida Barikin Ladi, Plateau State. Ibrahim Yusuf Babayo, shugaban MACBAN a jihar Plateau, ya tabbatar da abin da ya faru.

Who are these 'gunmen' and are they connected to any known groups or militias operating in Plateau State?

Is there a pattern of similar killings in this area, and how does this incident fit into the broader farmer-herder conflict narrative in Plateau State?
What evidence exists of the shooting, and are there eyewitnesses or investigations initiated by law enforcement?

Reports from the community noted that the incident happened in the early hours of Thursday, following an exchange of gunfire between the deceased and […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jami'in Dajin Kasu a Kogi ya mutu yayin da yake gida tun fuskar maharan. Jami'in Tsarin Karamar Daji mai suna Tuesday Michael Obamuroh an ce an kashe shi a waje na Iluke-Ofere a gundumar Kabba/Bunu a Kogi. Why are details about the exchange of gunfire incomplete - who fired first, what weapons were used, and were there witnesses beyond community reports?
Who benefits from framing this incident as a bandit attack versus investigating root causes (resource conflicts, governance gaps, displacement)?
Why is the article incomplete (indicated by [...]) and what crucial details about the victim's duties, the location's significance, or previous incidents in the area are omitted?
Have Forest Guard casualties in this region been increasing, and is there a pattern suggesting institutional vulnerability or coordination gaps?

Bayo Onanuga, Special Adviser to the President on Information and Strategy, disclosed this in a statement on Friday. He said the appointment fills a vacancy created by the resignation of Taiwo […]

Agboola Lukman Dabiri, tsohon abokin gwamnati na jihar Lagos, an nada shi a matsayin wakilin kudu-maso ga National Assembly Service Commission. Bayo Onanuga, Babbar Shawarci ga Shugaban kan Bayanai da Dabarun, ya sanar da hakan jiya.
critical_questions: What specific qualifications does Dabiri possess that justify this appointment, and how does he compare to other candidates considered?
